contentText:
The original Fairphone Fairbuds were some of the first wireless earbuds with replaceable parts. | Image: Fairphone

Following leaks revealing a major redesign earlier this month and an official teaser posted to X yesterday , Fairphone has shared some exclusive details with The Verge about the first follow-up to its Fairbuds wireless earbuds that debuted over two years ago.

A full reveal of the Fairbuds 2 is planned for October 14th, but we can confirm the new version will carry forward the same focus on repairability that made the original Fairbuds so unique with "seven fully replaceable and modular parts."
